newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: UOB gets insurance licence in Indonesia.
newsitem.headline: UOB gets insurance licence in Indonesia.

text.p: United Overseas Bank Group said on Tuesday its unit, UOB Life Assurance Ltd, had received a licence from Indonesia's Ministry of Finance to operate a joint-venture life assurer in the country.
UOB Group said in a statement the joint venture was called PT UOB Life-Sun Assurance.

It said the partners in the company, which began operating on November 13, were PT United Overseas Bank Bali, a UOB unit, with 15 percent and PT Sun Antarnusa Investment, a unit of Indonesia's Sunson Group, which holds 30 percent.
The controlling 55 percent stake is owned by UOB Life, said the statement.
PT UOB Life-Sun Assurance has an authorised capital of 15 billion rupiah and paid-up capital of 7.5 billion rupiah.
